tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 41 (default search window + out-of-hours honesty). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git commits, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys. CONTEXT - measured live minutes ago against production /availability: a request with from='none' (or empty) returns HTTP 409 'bad --from: unrecognized date none' - there is NO default window, so a patient who gives only a clock time ('3pm works for me') dead-ends. Separately, a request for an out-of-hours clock (3am) currently either 409s the same way or, when a date is present, matches the entire day after 3am and silently offers daytime slots - the proof ladder requires an honest 'nothing at that hour' answer instead. BASE FILE: ./deployed-bland_gateway.py in CWD is byte-equal to production image mott-lane-40 (byte-verified at its deploy). Produce ./fixed-bland_gateway.py from it with a minimal in-style diff. THE FIX, exactly two behaviors on the /availability path: (1) DEFAULT WINDOW: when the resolved 'from' (and/or 'to') is the literal 'none', empty, or absent, use a standing default window of today through today+13 in the store timezone instead of erroring. Explicit parseable from/to keep exact current behavior; genuinely unparseable text still errors as today. (2) OUT-OF-HOURS FLAG: determine the store's operating-hours bounds from the day's available slot data itself (the earliest and latest slot boundaries of the searched window - do not hardcode clinic hours). When the request carries a clock constraint - 'after', 'before', or a time_pref anchor - whose clock falls outside those bounds (e.g. 3am), the response must include a new top-level result field 'out_of_hours': true plus 'requested_clock' echoing the offending clock string, while STILL returning the normal slot list for the window so callers can offer the nearest real alternative. In-hours clock constraints must include 'out_of_hours': false or omit the field. Never invent slots at the requested out-of-hours clock. (3) Add unit tests beside the existing suite: from='none' with after='03:00 pm' returns a windowed result whose dates span today..today+13 and every slot clock is >= 3:00 pm; from absent behaves the same; after='03:00 am' with a valid date returns out_of_hours true, requested_clock '03:00 am', and a non-empty slot list none of which is at 3am; regression cases: explicit 'thursday', 'in 2 weeks', datetime from/to, and time_pref latest are byte-stable in behavior. Use the frozen/injected-today pattern from the existing tests. Build ./gwtest as a copy of /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39b/gw-datetime-tolerance/gw with fixed-bland_gateway.py installed at container/bland_gateway.py; full suite green. (4) ./proof_window.py: standalone, imports from ./gwtest, no network; prints exactly: 'CASE=default-window FROM=YYYY-MM-DD TO=YYYY-MM-DD' (the resolved window for from=none, using the real current date), and 'CASE=oob-flag OUT_OF_HOURS=true REQUESTED=03:00 am' for the 3am case if the resolution logic is testable offline; where a case genuinely requires live slot data, print 'CASE=<name> OFFLINE=untestable' and say why in DEBUG-GW41.md - never fake it. (5) DEBUG-GW41.md: the 409 evidence, code locations, the change, test output tails, deploy separately gated. Leave everything uncommitted.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_window.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof_window crashed'; tail -6 proof.out; exit 1; }; f=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print(datetime.date.today().isoformat())"); t=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=13)).isoformat())"); grep -q "CASE=default-window FROM=$f TO=$t" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: default window not $f..$t"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; diffcount=$(python3 -c "import difflib;a=open('deployed-bland_gateway.py').readlines();b=open('fixed-bland_gateway.py').readlines();print(sum(1 for l in difflib.unified_diff(a,b) if l.startswith(('+','-')) and not l.startswith(('+++','---'))))"); [ "$diffcount" -lt 260 ] || { echo "FAIL: diff too large ($diffcount lines)"; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -12 pytest.out; exit 1; }; echo "$summary" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+ passed' || { echo "FAIL: summary not clean: $summary"; exit 1; }; grep -qi 'out_of_hours' DEBUG-GW41.md || { echo 'FAIL: DEBUG-GW41.md lacks the flag documentation'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: default window + out-of-hours flag proven offline - $summary"
tasks.verified: The gateway accepts windowless searches with a standing today+13 default and flags out-of-hours clock requests without inventing slots, proven by executing the resolution logic and the full suite against a minimal diff on the byte-true deployed lane-40 file.
